div.head: VIII Atr Inscr.
div.ab: Anno MXIIII. ab incarnatione Domini nostri Iesu Christi.
Anno MXIIII. ab incarnatione Domini nostri Iesu Christi.
In the year 1014 after the incarnation of our Lord Jesus Christ.
In the year 1014 from the incarnation of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Im Jahre 1014 von der Fleischwerdung unseres Herrn Jesu Christi (D; Vom Sonderfrieden für Kirchen; Im Namen des Herrn G).
In the year 1014 from the incarnation of our Lord Jesus Christ (D; Of the special protection of churches; In the name of the Lord, G).
div.note: K: checked against Gesetze I p. ; Base text K = G (Cotton Nero A I f. 95v, after Grið, end of 11th c.) for Inscr.–5.2 only; D (CCCC 201 p. 93, after Polity 24, c. 1075) is also given here and is the only text from 6 onward. G's heading is in red; ‘Be cyricgriðe’ fits only chapters 1–5.2. Issued 1014, after February.
The rubric is in Latin. The Nero text has instead “Concerning sanctuary”, and, in Latin, “In the name of the Lord.”
